description:
Registrable domains whose name matches a pattern, written forwards: *agent.com, loop-*.com, [a-z]{4,10}agent.com. NEEDS AN API KEY ON THE PRO PLAN.

Naming the TLD makes the search a key range and about 60 times cheaper than a pattern that leaves it open. Every row carries its nameservers (ns) and cert_id; ns narrows the search to domains delegated to a nameserver. Page with after=<next_cursor>. A match is a name that fits the pattern, not evidence of intent: lookalike names are also registered defensively by the brands they resemble.

Use it when you know the shape of a name but not the name. For one known domain use lookup_domain, for a list of known domains lookup_domains, and for names registered recently whatever their shape new_domains. No match returns count 0, not an error.

after.description: The next_cursor from the previous call.

name.description: The pattern over the registrable domain, written forwards: * is any run of characters, [a-z]{4,10} a bounded class, e.g. "*agent.com" or "[a-z]{4,10}agent.com". End it with a literal TLD whenever you can; that is what keeps it cheap.

ns.description: Only domains delegated to this nameserver hostname, e.g. "ns1.example.net".

name: search_domains
title: Search domains by name pattern
